tieOut.heading: Budget and capacity
tieOut.untracedBody: They are not counted in any row above, so the delivered and capacity figures are low by that much.

owners.heading: Who answers for each portfolio
owners.body: Their automatic work and its approvals go to them.

investment.heading: Investment balance
investment.intro: Direction for funded work. Bug fixes normally count as repair.
investment.empty: No funding scope is assigned to you. The recorded budget owner can set the allocation.
investment.unavailable: Allocation is unavailable. Recorded ownership or policy needs review before using this budget.
investment.inactive: This allocation has expired or is not yet active. Save a renewed allocation to use it for future work.
investment.measured: {$repair}% repair among classified tokens · {$tokens} known tokens
investment.coverage: {$known} measured attempts · {$classified} · {$unknown} attempts with unknown usage. External agent spending is unobserved.
investment.gapExplanation: Unassigned attempts do not enter your allocation. Attempts with an unknown organization are outside this report.
investment.preferenceWaiting: Automatic preference is waiting for sufficient, recent coverage.
investment.preferRepair: Prefer repair within this funding scope.
investment.preferNew: Prefer new work within this funding scope.
investment.withinTolerance: The measured balance is within tolerance.
investment.defaultDetails: Versioned default: development-investment.default.v1. No owner override is recorded.
investment.balance: Balance repair and new work · 50% repair
investment.steering: Prefer underfunded work when coverage is sufficient
investment.installationExplanation: Use this scope for matching work without room or portfolio funding on this installation. Other installations keep their own bindings.
investment.anotherOwner: Another owner funds this work. Ownership must be resolved before rebinding.
investment.successor: Recorded ownership has changed. Confirm the successor funding scope; historical spending stays with its original owner.
investment.saveFailed: The change could not be saved. Reload to check its current state before retrying.
investment.concurrentChange: The allocation changed while you were editing. Reload before trying again.
investment.ownerRequired: The recorded funding owner must authorize this change.
investment.installationLinkIntro: Funding follows its owner and purpose.

hostPosture.heading: How this computer keeps the platform running
hostPosture.notReported: Not reported yet. The settings are read the next time the platform starts after someone signs in.
hostPosture.noChecks: No checks exist yet for this kind of computer.
hostPosture.adviceOnly: Suggestions only. The platform never changes these settings.

fundingSetup.intro: The shared platform owner has not been recorded. Review the person and organization before confirming.
fundingSetup.consequence: This records {$person} as platform policy and funding owner for {$organization} on this installation.
fundingSetup.default: No allocation override is recorded. Shared platform work will use the founder default:
fundingSetup.explicit: Existing allocation retained. Shared platform work will keep this target:
fundingSetup.inactive: This allocation has expired or is not yet active. Recording ownership does not renew it; renew the allocation before funding new work.
fundingSetup.preservation: Existing allocations and spending history are preserved. Policy versions still need separate ratification. Workroom funding is applied separately.
fundingSetup.attestation: I am authorized to record this platform policy and funding owner.
fundingSetup.saved: Platform ownership recorded. Existing allocations and history are preserved; Workroom funding is applied separately.
fundingSetup.recordedBody: This setup cannot replace an existing owner. Review the exact ownership record below.
fundingSetup.noOrganizations: No eligible owner organization is available on this page. An organization must record your accountability before it can be selected.
fundingSetup.stale: The ownership record or allocation changed. Reload it, review the current details, and confirm your authority again.
fundingSetup.denied: Your current account does not have permission to record this platform ownership. Reload to check your current access.
fundingSetup.conflict: Ownership is already recorded or the existing fields conflict. Reload to review the current record; this setup cannot replace it.
fundingSetup.invalid: Choose an organization, enter a reason and confirm your authority before recording ownership.
fundingSetup.unavailable: The ownership record could not be loaded or confirmed. Reload it before trying to confirm ownership.
fundingSetup.uncertain: Confirmation could not be verified. Reload the ownership record to check whether it was saved before trying again.
fundingSetup.installationUnavailable: The installation identity is unavailable. Ownership cannot be recorded until it is restored.
fundingSetup.profileUnavailable: The platform policy profile is unavailable or inactive. Ownership cannot be recorded until it is restored.
fundingSetup.allocationUnavailable: The existing allocation could not be read. Ownership cannot be confirmed without its current target and validity.
fundingSetup.conflictBody: The ownership fields are incomplete or conflict. This setup cannot replace them. Review the exact record before arranging a correction.
